title: Real-time RT-PCR
author: Yuejun Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iencbde

steps.title: Isolate Total RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate total RNA from MSCs using TRIzol Reagent (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA).

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Set up reverse transcription reactions according to the manufacturer's protocol (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA).

steps.title: Run Real-time PCR
steps.instruction: Perform real-time PCR using the QuantiTect SYBR Green PCR kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) and an Icycler iQ Multi-color Real-time PCR Detection System.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reactions in duplicate with 1 μl of cDNA template in a 20 μl reaction volume
Run the program: 95°C for 15 min, followed by 40 cycles of 94°C for 15 s, 60°C for 30 s, and 72°C for 30 s
Confirm amplification specificity via melting curve

steps.title: Analyze mRNA Levels
steps.instruction: Calculate the relative mRNA level of the target gene using the threshold cycle (Ct) relative to GAPDH.

substeps.instruction: Apply the formula 2^-△Ct, where △Ct = GAPDH Ct - gene of interest Ct
